content: Chime continues to drive value to our members and employer partners.  Really exciting partnership, and looking forward to driving great outcomes for Allied employees.

Earned wage access has come a long way since the payroll headache it once was.

I’m excited to partner with PayrollOrg (formerly the American Payroll Association and GPMI) for an upcoming webinar with Kira Rubiano, Partner at Payrollminds, to discuss what payroll-first EWA looks like today, and why it’s becoming easier than ever to implement and manage.

We’ll also share new PayrollOrg survey findings and practical guidance for evaluating solutions, whether you’re considering EWA for the first time or replacing a legacy solution.

Excited to represent Chime Workplace. Hope you’ll join us.

📅 August 6 | 1:00 PM EDT

Register here: https://bit.ly/4fpcBde

In 20+ years of workplace benefits, savings is the piece most programs still get wrong. Helping employees build savings is good for them, and good for business.

I'm joining Workday's Aimee Greene to talk through what actually moves the needle: A Playbook for Boosting Employee Savings.

📅 July 22, 10am PT / 1pm ET
🔗 Register: https://bit.ly/4eWhw3y
